dialogue.content: トラブルになってしまい済みませんでした
dialogue.English: I apologize for the trouble.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ(◠‿◕)宜しくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's alright (◠‿◕). I look forward to it, too.

dialogue.content: 始めてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 初めにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか?
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: ご近所トラブルでちょっと困っていて…
dialogue.English: I'm having a bit of trouble with a neighbor...

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね
dialogue.English: That must be tough.

dialogue.content: どのようなことでトラブルになっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of trouble are you having?

dialogue.content: 隣のお家の方がのら猫に餌をやっていて、それでうちにウンチしたりゴミをあさりにきたりしていて…
dialogue.English: The neighbor next door is feeding stray cats, and as a result, they come into our yard to poop and rummage through our trash...

dialogue.content: 猫にウンチされたり、ゴミをあさられたりしたらたまりませんね
dialogue.English: Having cats poop on your property and go through your trash must be unbearable.

dialogue.content: 夏場になると匂いとかが出てしまって、ゴミも片付けるのがけっこう手間で
dialogue.English: In the summer, it starts to smell, and it's quite a hassle to clean up the trash.

dialogue.content: そうですよねとても嫌な思いをされているんですね
dialogue.English: I understand. You must be feeling very upset.

dialogue.content: 隣の方にはそのことを伝えていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken to your neighbor about this?

dialogue.content: ええ、個人的には猫は好きなんですが、隣の方がちょっと付き合いにくい人なので下手に話せなくて…
dialogue.English: Well, I personally like cats, but my neighbor is a bit difficult to deal with, so I can't just bring it up easily...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話したくても話せないのはもどかしいですね
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating to want to say something but not be able to.

dialogue.content: そうですね、賃貸ではないので引っ越しという訳にもいかないので…
dialogue.English: That's right. And since it's not a rental, moving isn't really an option...

dialogue.content: 付き合いにくいというのはどんな感じの方なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What makes them difficult to deal with?

dialogue.content: 行き違ってしまいました
dialogue.English: Sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.content: 町内会の行事や集金の時などよく揉めているようで、私も一度そういう目にあってしまったので、余計に話せなくなってしまって
dialogue.English: They seem to get into arguments often during neighborhood association events or when collecting dues, and I had a similar experience with them once, which makes it even harder for me to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかいろいろな人とトラブルになるような人なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so they're the type of person who gets into trouble with various people.

dialogue.content: あなたご自身も嫌な思いをされたことがあると
dialogue.English: And you've had an unpleasant experience with them yourself.

dialogue.content: なかなか苦情も言いづらいですよね
dialogue.English: That would make it very difficult to complain, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: ええ、直接言うのはちょっと怖いですね…
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a bit scared to say something to them directly...

dialogue.content: そう感じるのももっともだと思います
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.content: 町内の方で相談に乗ってもらえそうな人はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone in your neighborhood association you could talk to about this?

dialogue.content: よく町内の役員さんとは話はしますが、やはりみなさんあまり深く関わらない方がいいというような感じで、我慢するしかないよね、なんて話はしていますね
dialogue.English: I often talk with the neighborhood association officers, but everyone seems to feel it's better not to get too involved, and we end up just saying things like, 'I guess we just have to put up with it.'

dialogue.content: そうなんですかみんなその人と関わるのを敬遠しているんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so everyone avoids getting involved with that person.

dialogue.content: 我慢ですか・・・そう言われてもしんどいですよね
dialogue.English: 'Just put up with it,' huh... That must be hard to hear, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 匂いとか、ゴミとか不衛生ですしね
dialogue.English: The smell and the trash are unsanitary, too.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 気に入らないと怒鳴りますし、なんか怒らせて事件になったりするのも嫌ですし…
dialogue.English: They yell when they're displeased, and I don't want to anger them and have it turn into a bigger incident...

dialogue.content: 怒鳴られるのは嫌ですよねこれまでに、どんな揉めごとがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Being yelled at is awful. What kind of trouble have you had with them before?

dialogue.content: 個人的な事では、子供の事でクレームをつけられる事はありましたね…
dialogue.English: Personally, they've complained about my child before...

dialogue.content: 今、家には乳児がいるので夜泣きなどがあって、主人には寝られないと言われるので外であやしたりするのですが、それが煩いと怒鳴られる事はありました
dialogue.English: I have an infant at home right now who cries at night, and my husband says he can't sleep, so I sometimes go outside to soothe the baby, but I've been yelled at for being too loud.

dialogue.content: 乳児に夜泣きされたら、外であやしたくもなりますよね
dialogue.English: When an infant is crying at night, it's natural to want to soothe them outside.

dialogue.content: それを怒鳴られたら本当に困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Being yelled at for that must be really distressing.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: のら猫のこと以外にもあるんですね
dialogue.English: So there are other issues besides the stray cats.

dialogue.content: 他にも気を使うことかおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are there other things you have to be careful about?

dialogue.content: ええ、何かとあって話しきれないですね
dialogue.English: Yes, there are so many things I can't even begin to tell you all of them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ、猫の事は主人が一番嫌っているので、なんとかそれを一番におさめたいところです…
dialogue.English: Yes, my husband hates the cat issue the most, so I really want to resolve that one first...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか何とかしたいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. You really want to do something about it, don't you?

dialogue.content: これまでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたのお住まいの隣によく揉めごとを起こす人が住んでいる
dialogue.English: A person who often causes trouble lives next door to you.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その人がのら猫に餌を与えるので、のら猫が家の近くでウンチをしたりゴミをあさったりしてとても迷惑していらっしゃる
dialogue.English: That person feeds stray cats, which causes them to poop near your house and rummage through your trash, which is a big nuisance for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 注意したいけれど、あなた自身もお子さんのことでクレームを言われたこともあり、
dialogue.English: You want to say something, but you've also received complaints from them about your child,

dialogue.content: 怖くてとても注意することができない
dialogue.English: and you're too scared to confront them.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 匂いがしたりしてとても不愉快のことに我慢がならないけれど
dialogue.English: You can't stand how unpleasant it is with the smell and everything,

dialogue.content: 賃貸ではないので引っ越すわけにもいかない
dialogue.English: but since you own your home, moving isn't an option.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたら、餌やりを止めてもらうことができきるのか？
dialogue.English: So the question is, how can you get them to stop feeding the cats?

dialogue.content: ということですよね
dialogue.English: Is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうですね、直接的でなくなにか伝わる方法はないかなと思いまして
dialogue.English: That's right. I was wondering if there's an indirect way to get the message across.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 直接的でなく　　ですか
dialogue.English: Something indirect, you mean?

dialogue.content: ええ、回覧板では注意事項としてまわしてもらうなどの配慮をいただいたんですが、それも効果なくて…
dialogue.English: Yes, we had a notice circulated in the neighborhood newsletter about it, but that didn't have any effect...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですか
dialogue.English: Oh, is that so?

dialogue.content: ゴミあらしは我が家だけではなかったようでして
dialogue.English: It seems we weren't the only ones whose trash was being rummaged through.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 他の方も被害に遭われているのですね
dialogue.English: So other people are affected as well.

dialogue.content: そうみたいですね…
dialogue.English: It seems so...

dialogue.content: その方とはお話されてみましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to those people?

dialogue.content: ゴミあらしで困っている方ですか？
dialogue.English: The people who are having trouble with the trash?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あ、はい。近くの家の方なのでよく挨拶などはするので
dialogue.English: Oh, yes. They live nearby, so we often greet each other.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その方はどんな風におっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: What do they say about it?

dialogue.content: ええ、言っても仕方ないから生ゴミは外に出さないって言ってました
dialogue.English: Well, they said there's no point in complaining, so they just don't put their food waste outside anymore.

dialogue.content: そういう考えかたもあるんですね
dialogue.English: That's one way to think about it.

dialogue.content: それを聞いてあなたはどう感じましたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: 生ゴミを家に入れておくのは私は無理だなって感じました
dialogue.English: I felt that I couldn't keep food waste inside the house.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね家によって事情は違いますからね
dialogue.English: I see. Every household has different circumstances.

dialogue.content: 本当に困ってしまいますね
dialogue.English: This is a really difficult situation.

dialogue.content: 猫が嫌いな粉を播くというのを聞いたことがあるのですが
dialogue.English: I've heard there's a powder that cats dislike that you can sprinkle.

dialogue.content: それは猫に害はなさそうなものですか？
dialogue.English: Is it something that won't harm the cats?

dialogue.content: そこは自分で調べるべきですよね(笑)
dialogue.English: I should probably look that up myself, shouldn't I? (laughs)

dialogue.content: もしかしたらそれは効果あるかもしれないですよね、ちょっと調べてみます。
dialogue.English: That might actually be effective. I'll look into it.

dialogue.content: 私はあまり詳しくないので農薬とか置いてあるお店に聞いてみるのも1つかと思います
dialogue.English: I'm not very knowledgeable myself, so asking at a store that sells pesticides or similar items might be a good idea.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、少し検討してみます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. I'll consider it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうですね是非検討してみてください
dialogue.English: Yes, please do look into it.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I will.

dialogue.content: それと、砂利が敷き詰めてあったり、砂場のような所に猫がウンチをするので
dialogue.English: Also, cats tend to poop in places covered with gravel or in sandpit-like areas,

dialogue.content: 庭の地面を工夫されるといいかもしれません
dialogue.English: so it might help to make some adjustments to the surface of your yard.

dialogue.content: 実は我が家の庭にも以前猫にウンチをされていたことがあったのですが
dialogue.English: Actually, we used to have a problem with cats pooping in our yard as well,

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: 1センチくらいの穴の金網を敷き詰めてそれを防いだことがありました
dialogue.English: and we solved it by laying down wire mesh with holes about one centimeter wide.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 我が家は主人がそこまでするとキレそうなので、とりあえず粉の方で検討してみます
dialogue.English: My husband would probably lose his temper if we went that far, so I’ll consider the powder option for now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 一度お店の人に相談してみるといいと思います
dialogue.English: I think it would be a good idea to consult with someone at a store.

dialogue.content: ええ、多分なんでうちがそんな事しなきゃいけないんだって。言いそうです(笑)そうですね、一度私も自分で調べてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, he'd probably say, 'Why do *we* have to be the ones to do all that?' (laughs) You're right, I'll look into it myself as well.

dialogue.content: 是非そうしてみてください
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: はい、教えて下さってありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for the advice.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談にきてくださりありがとうごさいます
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: またお困りのときは相談にきてください
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back anytime you need to talk.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは本日の相談を終わらせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May we bring today’s session to a close?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: それでは終了とさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Then we will conclude here.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。なかなか難しいなと思いながら受けていました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Good work. I felt this was quite a difficult session. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （忌憚のないコメントをお待ちしています。）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to your candid comments.)

dialogue.content: （それではロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Shall we end the role-play now?)

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました(◠‿◕)
dialogue.English: Thank you for today (◠‿◕).

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。それでは終了いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. We will now conclude.
